_doc: Maps an ERP/admissions-office export onto the canonical funnel columns. Keys are canonical names; values are header spellings accepted (case/space-insensitive). See docs/data_ingest.md.

programme_aliases._doc: Extra spellings -> programme_id, e.g. "bsc nursing|siwan": "SIW-BSCN". Name-only keys work when the name is unique.
